title: 147873183 - 42-t-7585721-20060476F-001-004-2013
doc_notes: This document is a transcript of remarks by President Bill Clinton at a Christmas tree lighting ceremony in Belfast, Northern Ireland, in 1995, which includes a brief mention of the Roswell incident.

incidents.summary: President Clinton addresses a question from a 13-year-old boy regarding the 1947 Roswell alien spacecraft crash.
incidents.explanation: The President denies knowledge of an alien spacecraft crash or recovery of alien bodies.
incidents.quote: No, as far as I know, an alien spacecraft did not crash in Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947.
